SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) ids, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to), sum(CASE WHEN valid_to='9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) open_ended
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) max_sale, (SELECT max(week_ending_date) FROM fact_stock_week) max_stock, (SELECT max(business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales) max_rpt, (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member) n_versions, (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) n_ids

WITH cur AS (SELECT * FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND valid_to='9999-12-31'),
act AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04'-364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04')
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM cur) gold_current, (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE join_date > DATE '2026-10-07') future_join, (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE valid_from > DATE '2026-10-07') future_ver, (SELECT count(*) FROM cur c JOIN act USING(member_id)) gold_active, (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM stg_member_updates)) in_stg, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to='9999-12-31' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_open, (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM cur WHERE home_store_id=999) home999
